crossRefs.note: You meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, those who remember you in your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we…
He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know…
He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of…
But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s…
But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of…
All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of…

translations.web: Lord, men live by these things; and my spirit finds life in all of them: you restore me, and cause me to live.
translations.bsb: O Lord, by such things men live, and in all of them my spirit finds life. You have restored me to health and have let me live.
translations.kjv: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
translations.asv: O Lord, by these things men live; And wholly therein is the life of my spirit: Wherefore recover thou me, and make me to live.
